title: Bare same-tick re-step silently re-runs the tick body (double flow service + extra RNG draw); the cited step_once convention does not exist
detail: Verified empirically: Step(S,1);Step(S,1) redraws the nonce (2399007886→4293122540), double-serves an on-edge packet (progress 0→15), changes the hash, never latches ReplayError — the silent divergence the r1 fix left asymmetric.
recommended_fix: Latch ReplayError on every Tick == State.Tick re-step (drop the NumCommands > 0 condition) or return early making re-step idempotent; the only caller relying on the allowance is tests/spine_check.cpp:522-523 itself.

title: BuildProbeScenario's doc comment is detached — SpawnFixture's comment and definition sit between it and its function
detail: SpawnFixture was inserted between BuildProbeScenario's header comment and its body; the shared golden builder's description now visually documents SpawnFixture, and BuildProbeScenario (line 54) has no adjacent doc.
recommended_fix: Move the BuildProbeScenario comment block down to sit directly above inline void BuildProbeScenario, leaving SpawnFixture's own comment attached to SpawnFixture.
